prompt:
Flat 2D side-elevation game sprite concept art, STRICTLY ORTHOGONAL FRONT VIEW like a character reference sheet — NOT isometric, NOT three-quarter, NOT a diorama, no receding side walls, no visible depth/perspective. Think: a Metroidvania boss sprite reference painted straight-on, silhouette-first.

Subject: "the Verse-bearer," a great seated bell-shaped stone-and-metal entity fused flat against a wall, viewed dead-on from the front, cold dormant state. Exactly three flat, clearly separated silhouette masses, stacked vertically: (1) CHAMBER at the base — a wide, low, smoothly curved bell-body, like a huge inverted bell resting on the ground, built from one continuous bell-curve arc, no straight edges; (2) FRAME behind/around it — a plain, simple arched stone surround the chamber sits inside, echoing a rounded doorway or apse, minimal detail, no bricks drawn individually, no architectural ornament; (3) APERTURE — a small closed slit or collapsed pucker near the top of the chamber, NOT a circular eye-like hole, NOT a drain shape — a tight horizontal seam, like a closed mouth of a bell or a sealed slit in the stone, with a sagging fabric-like collapsed membrane just barely suggested behind it.

Absolutely CRITICAL rendering rule: NO OUTLINES. Do not draw any black or dark contour line around any shape. Every edge between two forms must be a soft flat color-value change only — like solid flat-shaded low-poly game art, or gouache blocked in flat shapes with no linework at all. If you would normally ink a silhouette edge, do not — use only a value shift.

A single thin crack, dark and unlit (matte charcoal, not a glowing line), runs as one continuous path from low on the chamber, up across the aperture area, toward one shoulder of the bell form — thin, subtle, NOT a bold black outline-weight crack.

Palette — strictly muted cool-leaning warm neutrals, NO bright colors: stone body in flat mid-brown (#806450 / #a8876b range), pale dusty plaster highlight only on rim edges (#bda880 / #ded0a8), and a few small dark tarnished bronze-green fitting shapes at the base and rim (#4d6152 / #6f8f74) — dull flat color patches, not detailed metal reflections. Absolutely no gold, yellow, orange, or glowing colors anywhere.

Forbidden: any outline or contour linework of any kind; isometric or 3/4 perspective; any face, eyes, or eye-like circular details; brick texture; architectural ornament detail; any glow or emissive color; insect anatomy; skull/ribcage read; readable musical notation; neon colors; lens flare; text or watermark.

Flat solid dark background, no gradient, no floor plane, no shadow cast — pure silhouette-forward flat character sheet composition, centered, full figure visible.
